answer: The knoll explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the onyx binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 3 separate vaults requires a separate funded juniper account and a separate escrow deposit for each, so that the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 277 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
